days.title: Overnight flight
days.body: Depart Boston in the afternoon. In the air overnight.

days.title: Arrive and walk Alfama
days.body: Early landing, drop bags, walk the neighbourhood, dinner at Casa Amarelo.

days.title: Optional Sintra day
days.body: If Sintra is confirmed, morning train and a palaces walk. Otherwise a slow Lisbon day and the riverfront.

days.title: Morning in the city, afternoon flight home
days.body: Checkout at 11:00. Flight TP217 around midday.
